annotations.title: List the LLM providers for bring-your-own-key AI

description: List the LLM providers the engine accepts for bring-your-own-key AI designs (POST /api/qr/ai/generate), with each provider id, its default model and the recommended model ids. Any model id your provider offers works; the list is a recommendation, not an allowlist. qr_generate_ai does not need this: it uses the managed path with our keys.
name: qr_list_ai_providers

count.description: How many providers the engine lists.

modelsNote.description: Reminder that the model list is a recommendation, not an allowlist.

providers.description: The providers, in the engine's order.

acceptsAnyModel.description: True: any model id the provider offers is accepted.

availableModels.description: Recommended model ids for this provider.

defaultModel.description: Model used when the request omits `llmModel`.

title: List the LLM providers for bring-your-own-key AI
